stories.title: AI credit cracks ahead of AI equities
stories.summary: CoreWeave 2031 bonds at 74 cents (17.9% yield), CDS at 1,332bp and banks selling Stargate and Oracle loans in the mid-80s show debt markets rationing AI capex funding. A B300 resale glut after the China remote-access curbs lowers the GPU collateral behind these loans, and SoftBank's Arm-backed borrowing adds reflexive selling. (red team weakened 2→1)

The feed says: Bonds imply >70% five-year default odds; equity at $42.57 still prices survival with upside
Edge: Falling GPU resale values and next week's $4.5B loan sale are credit-desk stories equity holders rarely model. The last report's version was the only scored idea, at +2.3 points over the S&P.
